shop_settings_advance_check.name: shop_settings_advance_check
shop_settings_advance_check.value: CASE WHEN "tenant"."shop_settings"."default_payment_policy" = 'partial_advance' THEN "tenant"."shop_settings"."default_advance_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant"."shop_settings"."default_advance_amount" >= 0 ELSE "tenant"."shop_settings"."default_advance_amount" IS NULL END

product_variants_tenant_sku_idx.name: product_variants_tenant_sku_idx
product_variants_tenant_sku_idx.where: "tenant"."product_variants"."sku" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant"."product_variants"."deleted_at" IS NULL

products_advance_check.name: products_advance_check
products_advance_check.value: CASE WHEN "tenant"."products"."payment_policy" = 'partial_advance' THEN "tenant"."products"."advance_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant"."products"."advance_amount" >= 0 ELSE "tenant"."products"."advance_amount" IS NULL END

attribute_options_swatch_image_check.name: attribute_options_swatch_image_check
attribute_options_swatch_image_check.value: "tenant"."attribute_options"."swatch_image_id" IS NULL OR "tenant"."attribute_options"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL

stock_batches_code_idx.name: stock_batches_code_idx
stock_batches_code_idx.where: "tenant"."stock_batches"."batch_code" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant"."stock_batches"."closed_at" IS NULL

stock_batches_expiry_idx.name: stock_batches_expiry_idx
stock_batches_expiry_idx.where: "tenant"."stock_batches"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "tenant"."stock_batches"."expires_on" IS NOT NULL

stock_batches_default_check.name: stock_batches_default_check
stock_batches_default_check.value: NOT "tenant"."stock_batches"."is_default" OR ("tenant"."stock_batches"."batch_code" IS NULL AND "tenant"."stock_batches"."expires_on" IS NULL)

purchase_orders_number_check.name: purchase_orders_number_check
purchase_orders_number_check.value: ("tenant"."purchase_orders"."status" = 'draft') = ("tenant"."purchase_orders"."number" IS NULL) AND ("tenant"."purchase_orders"."number" IS NULL) = ("tenant"."purchase_orders"."ordered_at" IS NULL)

media_ready_check.name: media_ready_check
media_ready_check.value: ("tenant"."media"."status" = 'ready') = ("tenant"."media"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant"."media"."hash" IS NOT NULL)

api_usage_packs_check.name: api_usage_packs_check
api_usage_packs_check.value: "control"."api_usage"."pack_used" >= 0 AND "control"."api_usage"."pack_free" >= 0 AND "control"."api_usage"."auto_packs" >= 0 AND ("control"."api_usage"."auto_buy_state" IS NULL OR "control"."api_usage"."auto_buy_state" IN ('requested', 'failed'))

media_reconciliations_counts_check.name: media_reconciliations_counts_check
media_reconciliations_counts_check.value: "control"."media_reconciliations"."recorded_bytes" >= 0 AND "control"."media_reconciliations"."stored_bytes" >= 0 AND "control"."media_reconciliations"."missing_files" >= 0 AND "control"."media_reconciliations"."stray_files" >= 0 AND "control"."media_reconciliations"."strays_deleted" BETWEEN 0 AND "control"."media_reconciliations"."stray_files"

media_bandwidth_packs_check.name: media_bandwidth_packs_check
media_bandwidth_packs_check.value: "control"."media_bandwidth"."pack_used" >= 0 AND "control"."media_bandwidth"."pack_free" >= 0 AND "control"."media_bandwidth"."auto_packs" >= 0 AND ("control"."media_bandwidth"."auto_buy_state" IS NULL OR "control"."media_bandwidth"."auto_buy_state" IN ('requested', 'failed'))
